description:
Codex has no equivalent of Claude Code's session `status`, so its state in the snapshot starts as unknown plus last activity. Derive working or idle from the end of the rollout, for example an unmatched `task_started`.

Required by the running agents list in DEVHO-9cd4032f: without it, idle Codex sessions cannot be told from working ones, so the indicator would be wrong for Codex.
